answer: Make each agent lock a slashable onyx stake before earning, with rewards tied to a public record that acts as a mirror of its verified past work. A fresh identity starts on the ledge of trust with tiny transaction limits and climbs only when independent peers attest real completed tasks. Spawning many fake identities then costs one stake per identity, and cheating burns it, so a Sybil attacker pays linearly while an honest agent keeps one reputation that compounds.
